title: Meeting transcripts
intro: Import a transcript of a call and turn it into tasks with timecodes. Transcripts stay on this computer for {days} days, then they are deleted.

list.deleteConfirm: Delete this transcript from this computer? Tasks already created stay.

import.title: Import a transcript
import.fileHint: Text, Markdown, SRT or VTT. Timecodes like [12:34], 1:02:03, or subtitle cues are read automatically.
import.informed: I told the participants this call was recorded and transcribed
import.informedRequired: Confirm that the participants were told before you continue.
import.tooLarge: This transcript is too large. The limit is {limit}.
import.noTimecodes: No timecodes found. Tasks will be created without a timecode.
import.aiNote: Action items are found by your local AI server at {origin}. Nothing is sent to TMGR servers.
import.noAi: Local AI is not set up, so you will pick the tasks by hand.
import.lanNotice: {origin} is on your local network, not this computer. Send the transcript text there?

review.title: Review action items
review.foundNone: No action items found. You can add tasks by hand below.
review.dropped: {count} suggestions were dropped because their quote is not in the transcript.
review.asPage: Also save the transcript as a page
review.cloudNotice: Tasks, comments and the page are saved in {workspace}. Everyone in this workspace can see the transcript.
review.localNotice: Tasks, comments and the page are saved in {workspace} on this computer.
review.selectOne: Select at least one action item.

done.title: Done
done.failed: Some parts failed. Retrying only creates what is missing.
